stem: Use m1=2 kg, m2=3 kg, l1=1 m, l2=2 m, θ1=30°, θ2=60°, g=10 m/s², qdot=(1,2) rad/s and qddot=(1/2,−1/4) rad/s². The tool-axis J=[[√3/2,0],[5/2,2]] and Jdot=[[1,0],[−√3,0]]. Using the source’s complete transformed dynamics, which Vx, task force F and back-transformed joint torque τ agree, rounded to0.001?
assumptions: Planar2R model with massless links, point mass m1 at the elbow and m2 at the second tip; θ1 measured upward from horizontal, θ2 relative, gravity downward. No friction or extra loads. All task vectors use the displayed rotating tool axes; a_c=d(v_T)/dt is the derivative of velocity components, not inertial acceleration components.
Use sin60°=√3/2, cos60°=1/2 and θ1+θ2=90°; retain full precision until final rounding.
